next_chapter_needs_conception: Finish the conception first: a chapter can only be added to a book that is active.
next_chapter_archived: This book is archived, so no new chapter can be added. Unarchive it first.
characters_hint: Drag to reorder the ranking; 1 is the most important character.
no_characters_hint: Add the cast the story needs; the conception agent can also propose them.
delete_character_body: The character design is deleted. Existing canon entities are not affected.
pause_after_outline: Approve each chapter outline before it takes effect
canon_systems_hint: Choose what agents read and maintain. A disabled system stays in the book and can be viewed at any time.
canon_system_hint.entities: Characters, organizations, places and items; also the protagonist card and mid-term entity evidence.
canon_system_hint.timeline: Story events and their entity links.
canon_system_hint.memory: Chapter summaries, facts, world rules and memory notes.
canon_system_hint.foreshadowing: Planted hooks and their resolution state.
canon_system_hint.goals: Writing goals, plans and tasks injected into agent context.
canon_systems_footnote: Nothing is deleted. Running sessions keep the system set they started with; chapters approved while a system is off are not recorded into it later.
memory_off_recent_warning: Memory is off and recent chapters in full is 0: the writer will not see earlier text.
system_off_banner: This system is off for this book: agents neither read nor maintain it.
recent_chapter_count_hint: How many prior official chapters the writer and the planner receive in full. 0 disables it.
writing_skills_hint: Selected skills are sent in full to every writing, revision and review session of this book. The choice applies to new sessions.
writing_skills_warn: More than 8,000 characters of instruction text. It is sent on every session; consider trimming it. Saving is not blocked.
writing_skills_empty: No skills are available yet. Create one on the Writing skills page.
writing_skills_applies: The choice applies to new sessions.
model_overrides_hint: Which model each agent role uses in this book. A role without an override uses the global default from Settings › Agent roles; the change applies to the next session.
model_global_default_none: No global default is set for this role.
model_override_missing: The model set here no longer exists. Pick another model or the global default.
model_overrides_needs_active: Finalize the conception first: the conception flow chooses the roles until the book is active.
model_overrides_archived: This book is archived. Unarchive it to change its roles.
proposal.description: Changes the archivist suggests for the setting materials. Accept applies them; reject dismisses them.
proposal.empty_body: Maintenance creates proposals when the text contradicts or extends the setting materials.
proposal.conflict_toast: The target text changed; the proposal conflicts and was not applied.
new_side_story_description: A side story is its own track of chapters. An isolated side story can read the shared canon but never changes it.
side_synopsis_placeholder: What happens in this side story?
canon_mode_hint: An isolated side story reads the canon but its events never change it.
canon_mode_locked: The canon mode is locked: this side story already has an official chapter.
side_focus_hint: The focus character is this side story's protagonist for short-term memory.
side_story_hint: Premise, canon mode, anchor and chapters of this side story.
side_story_no_chapters_hint: Write the first chapter like any other chapter.
delete_side_story_body: The side story and all its chapters are deleted. Shared canon keeps its records; the side story's own canon rows and sessions are removed.
not_a_side_story_hint: The main story is managed from the navigator and the book overview.

conception.title: Conception studio
conception.subtitle: The agent drafts the setting materials; you review and finalize.
conception.no_session: No conception session yet. Use Start conception to begin.
conception.finalize_unapproved_body: Some setting materials were never approved. You can finalize anyway, but the agent's next sessions will use the text as it is now.
conception.no_characters: No character designs yet. The agent proposes them, or you can ask for one.

doc_placeholder.outline: The story outline. The agent writes it, and you can edit it whenever the agent is not running.

knowledge_check.title: Knowledge check
knowledge_check.still_running_confirm: The knowledge check is still running and keeps running. Start conception now?
knowledge_check.no_report: The check has not written a report yet.

next_action.continue_conception: Continue the conception with the agent
next_action.seed_canon: Build the canon from the character designs
next_action.runs_in_agent_panel: This run takes place in the agent panel on the right.
next_action.runs_in_agent_panel_collapsed: This run takes place in the agent panel, which is collapsed.
next_action.started_in_agent_panel: {{session}} started. Follow it in the agent panel on the right.
next_action.defer_research_hint: Not now: postpone these tasks and keep writing. Resume them from the research list.
